For the hobby of baking, the proposed skill assessment tool is a dedicated mobile application. This app would track user progression by logging mastered recipes and specific baking techniques, while also maintaining a digital gallery of finished products. To gamify the learning process, the app would award badges for reaching milestones, such as "Sourdough Specialist" or "Pastry Artisan." Additionally, it would include a community feature allowing users to share photos of their baked goods to receive feedback from peers and mentors.
